cohort: The study included 49889 pregnant women who underwent natural childbirth (29631), elective repeat Cesarean section (20148), or VBAC delivery (110).
finding: The study concluded that VBAC and natural delivery are associated with better maternal and fetal outcomes, along with being more satisfactory and safer, compared to repeat Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonatal outcomes, Apgar scores, and resuscitation needs were better for natural delivery and VBAC compared to repeat C-section, while maternal outcomes were better for VBAC and repeat C-section than natural childbirth.
